thread:
marta: Quick heads-up - opened a docs PR to update audit-log retention wording and refresh SDK export examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812 :eyes:
pranav: Thanks! Are we changing the SOC2 guidance text or just the API reference snippets?
marta: Both. SOC2 guidance needs softer phrasing around defaults and responsibility, plus python + curl examples under "audit exports". Want legal to sign off on TTL and pseudonymization language.
kelly: skimmed the PR. Code samples are fine but we should avoid stating a single retention window for all customers. Maybe present a sample TTL and note "typical ranges". Also there's a tiny flag mismatch in the curl example.
olivia-legal: agree with kelly. Please replace any phrase like "we retain audit logs for 90 days" with: "we retain audit logs according to customer configuration and applicable legal requirements (typical retention ranges: 30-365 days)". Add a short note about legal holds and customer obligations.
pranav: good catch. Can we add a short SDK snippet showing export-time redaction? e.g.:
```
# python illustrative: redact PII when exporting
from redwood import AuditExport
exporter = AuditExport(api_key=REDWOOD_API_KEY)
exporter.export(filter={"redact": ["email","ssn"]}, retention_days=90)
```
marta: I had a shorter example, will swap in that one and mark it as illustrative only.
kelly: also update the curl example flag from "--ttl" to "--retention-days" - the CLI expects the latter.
marta: fixed the flag, added the redaction snippet, and prefixed the snippet with a "Beta: sample" note for clarity.
ci-bot: docs CI: link-check OK, build passed for PR #812 :white_check_mark:
olivia-legal: please remove wording "SOC2-compliant retention default". Suggest: "Redwood provides configurable retention controls and audit export features designed to support SOC2 evidence collection; customers are responsible for selecting retention parameters that meet their obligations."
pranav: pasted and will use that verbatim.
marta: pushed changes, added internal link to retention policy, and placed a small note reminding users that export filters are illustrative and customers should validate against their legal needs.
kelly: looks good to me. One more nit: add an inline note to the SDK example about scope of redaction (export-level vs platform-level).
marta: added that comment. Ready to merge once legal confirms and eng does a final quick pass.
olivia-legal: wording approved from legal side. :thumbsup:
pranav: I'll do a quick engineering read and then we can merge. Thanks all!
marta: thanks team, will merge after pranav's check and then add a short changelog entry for docs release notes. :clap:
summary: Docs PR coordination thread updating SOC2/retention phrasing and audit-export SDK/curl examples. Legal requested softer compliance language and illustrative redaction snippet; CLI flag fixed; CI passed; awaiting final engineering review before merge.
